newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank allots 16.44 bln in repos.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank allots 16.44 bln in repos.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Friday it had allotted 16.44 billion schillings in two-week securities repurchase agreements at a fixed and unchanged rate of 3.0 percent.
The central bank said 14 percent of bids were filled.
Last week the central bank allotted 7.89 billion schillings, or six percent of bids, also at a rate of 3.0 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
